title: Silver Fox Gaming - AI integration scratchpad
body:
Context: Silver Fox Gaming (mid-size PC/console game studio) — wants an in-game conversational NPC + moderation pipeline for live player chat and short in-game content generation. Customer call 2026-02-10 (recording on Confluence). Notes below are from pre-call demo + followup sync.

Attendees (SFG): Alex Monroe (CTO), Jae Park (Lead Online Services), Mira Chen (Live Ops manager), Theo (security lead). Redwood: Maya (owner), Diego (solutions), Priya (account engineer).

High-level ask:
- Replace current rule-based chat moderation with an ML-based classifier + LLM reranking for borderline cases.
- Provide NPC dialogue generation for side-quests: short responses (<150 tokens), should respect canonical lore and not hallucinate names/loot.
- Hard latency requirement for in-game interactions: 95p tail <= 80ms for chat moderation path; NPC generation can be up to 250ms p95 but typical target ~120ms.
- Data residency: EU player data (for EU players) cannot leave EU regions (GDPR + publisher contract).
- Support bursty traffic (major events) up to 6x baseline traffic for short windows.
- Safety: high false-negative sensitivity for moderation (prefer false positives; ops will review appeals).

Key technical constraints / gotchas observed on call:
1) Stateful player sessions: They keep short-term conversation state (last 6 messages) on game servers and expect Redwood to accept a compacted context (session id + delta). We need to confirm session affinity and routing for Dedicated vs Hosted.
2) UDP telemetry pipeline: game servers batch telemetry and occasionally strip timestamps; when we do prompt evaluation for QA, missing timestamps break session reconstruction. Ask: can we support tolerant prompt stitching (server side library change) or require reliable ordering?
3) Anti-cheat overlap: Some telemetry flagged by anti-cheat cannot be sent to hosted API (because of obfuscation requirement). They may want Private deployment for EU region and to integrate with internal HSM.
4) Model fidelity: NPC generation must not output player PII or hints that enable exploits (e.g., exact spawn coordinates, sequence of RNG seeds). Need a blacklist + model filters + in-process function calling to sanitize outputs before returning to client.
5) Cost sensitivity: Live Ops wants to run moderation at scale — budget cap target €18k/month for moderation for EU region (ballpark). We'll need to propose batching + quantized model options to hit that.
6) Telemetry sampling for evals: they prefer sampling 5% of live chat for human review. We need lightweight sampling hook with S3 export (EU buckets).

Immediate technical questions to resolve (action owners inline):
- Can Redwood host a Private control plane in customer-managed VPC in eu-central? (Maya -> Priya to confirm available regions + Private package pricing)
- Does Redwood Dedicated support session stickiness by session-id with <10ms additional routing overhead? (Diego -> infra team ping)
- Which quantized models do we recommend for classification vs generation to hit latency/cost targets? (Priya -> build microbenchmarks)
- Can we provide a pre-deployment simulation script (local worker) to replay UDP-batched telemetry in order? (Maya -> provide sample logs; Diego to sketch replay tool)

Integration design sketch (rough):
- Path A (moderation fast-path): small classifier model (quantized 4-bit) hosted on Dedicated or Private in EU -> returns pass/block/needs-review. If needs-review, send to Path B. Keep local cache of recent verdicts (TTL 15s) to avoid repeat inference.
- Path B (borderline rerank): larger LLM reranker to decide contextually; runs in same region with async webhook to Live Ops dashboard. For borderline cases that are critical, immediate escalation to human via ticketing integration.
- NPC generation: medium-sized model (2-4B effective after quantization) with prompt templates that include lore constraints. Use Redwood Optimize to recommend quantization profile; enable prefix/KV caching for repeated NPC seeds.

Prompting & guardrails notes:
- Always prepend system: "SFG_WORLD: canonical lore: [LORE_SNIPPET]; RULES: never reveal coords, never reference real-player PII; strictly return neutral/descriptive output."
- Keep generation length <= 128 tokens. Use top-k + temperature control. Log generated output (EU-only) to S3 for sampling & eval; redact tokens that match PII regex before logging.

Compliance & Security:
- EU PII must remain in eu-central S3 and EU compute. Need KMS key controlled by SFG (customer-managed key). Private deployment option preferred.
- Audit logs: Ops wants 90-day access to moderation logs; longer-retention as paid add-on. Must confirm retention/egress costs.

Operational playbooks (initial draft):
- Canary rollout for moderation: start with 1% of EU chat -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 2-4 weeks. Monitor false negative rate + appeal volume.
- Event scaling: configure burst capacity policy for Dedicated pool (autoscale to 6x for max 30 min, cool down 15m). Add fallback to lower-cost hosted model if Dedicated saturated (but only for non-EU or non-sensitive sessions).

Next steps (owners + rough ETA):
- Priya: run perf matrix (latency/cost) for candidate models (classifier 0.5B, reranker 1.5B, generator 3B quantized) in eu-central; deliver by 2026-02-28.
- Diego: check Dedicated session affinity support + routing overhead; reply by 2026-02-21.
- Maya: produce sample UDP-batched logs + event day traffic profile from SFG (due 2026-02-17).
- Theo (SFG security): send KMS/HSM requirements + anti-cheat data masking constraints (due 2026-02-22).
- Create JIRA epic JIRA-ENG-2147 (owner: Maya) with subtasks for benchmark, infra check, compliance, integration SDK.

Loose open questions / discussion points for next call:
- Is SFG comfortable with hosting moderation on Hosted for non-EU traffic to save cost? Are there contractual blockers?
- For NPC hallucination mitigation, how much human-curated lore can they provide (structured JSON snippets)? Can we ingest into prompt templates or as a small vector DB for retrieval?
- How do they want appeals flow to hook into their existing ticketing (Jira/Linear)?

Quick wins to propose for next meeting:
- Demo a local replay tool that converts UDP batches to ordered events and shows a dry-run inference cost/latency.
- Provide sample prompt templates + generated examples with safety sandbox toggles.
- Share Redwood Optimize quick profile to show cost tradeoffs for quantization vs fidelity for their generator workload.

Notes to self: keep conversation concrete on numbers (p95, tokens/s, storage GB/month). Avoid vague promises about "no hallucinations" — propose mitigations. Record all data-flow diagrams in Confluence page linked above.

Meeting cadence: weekly sync for next 6 weeks; first follow-up scheduled 2026-02-24 (internal pre-brief 2026-02-22).

End of scratchpad.
